title: assure.RecordProofRun
description: Builds the proof run from the suites' output at the clean, full commit checked out, adds a failed outcome with the detail did not run for each automated test record that has none, refuses an unknown test ID or a signer that is not the trusted signer, and hands the proof run to the attestation store.

title: assure.GateChange
description: Measures the coverage at the base head and then at the change's commit with MeasureCoverage, so that a run of Lathe on the change's spec cannot alter the Lathe that measures the base, lists the workflow files that differ, verifies the proof run at the change's commit with VerifyAttestation, and reads the code faults of both commits' trees and specs with CodeFaults, and the retirements of the change's spec with ReadCommittedSpec. Refuses the change when holdsRatchet or proofRunPassed gives a cause, when the change's tree has a code-standard or user-doc fault that the base head does not have by rule and key, when docsLagChange finds a user doc that names a CLI command the change alters or removes and that the change leaves as it is (ST-STD-DOCS-R04), or when the only proof run is change grade and the workflows folder changed; a fault the base head already has is reported in the decision's code faults, not refused, and each retirement that holdsRatchet follows is reported in the decision's retirements. The decision names both commits and both coverages, lists every reason in the fixed order, is checked by the rules of the Gate decision, and is kept by the decision store.

title: assure.GateRelease
description: Measures the coverage at the release commit with MeasureCoverage, verifies the proof run there with VerifyAttestation and takes only a release-grade one, signed by the proof-run workflow at main, and reads the code faults of the commit's tree and spec with CodeFaults. Refuses the release unless fullyProved gives no reason, every share 100% and every automated test record passed, and the tree has no code-standard fault: the decision names each obligation by ID and share, each test record that did not pass, and each fault with its file or package and rule. The decision names only the commit, lists every reason in the fixed order, is checked by the rules of the Gate decision, and is kept by the decision store. A passed decision names the attestation the trusted signer at main is to make; once the store has kept it, it is handed over as the decision.json predicate, and it raises Release decided. When keeping or handing over fails, no predicate is written.

title: appbuild.ResolveDependencies
description: ResolveDependencies runs Go's module tools on a staged go.mod and go.sum with resolveModules, and hands them to Generating's compiler.CommitResolvedModules, which checks them and writes them through the apply journal. When Generating stages the runtime pin as a local module proxy, resolveModules puts that proxy before the GOPROXY that the Go configuration gives.

title: appbuild.Download
description: Download fetches the zips for one revision and checks them against go.sum. When go.mod requires the runtime library and the source revision holds registry/runtime, or --runtime-folder (DownloadOptions.RuntimeFolder) names the runtime folder of a STEGO checkout for a source that holds none, stageRuntimeFolder refuses a link or a special file in that folder, writes its module zip as the pin, checks the zip and its go.mod against go.sum, the zip against the runtime pins the binary carries (runtimePins), and against sum.golang.org when it knows the version, and only then serves them as a file proxy named by an escaped file URL before proxy.golang.org; --runtime-folder is refused for a source with its own folder, a go.mod with no runtime pin and a folder with no go.mod. The cache record names the source of each module (source:registry/runtime or checkout:registry/runtime for the pin), and Build copies that source into the build record, from which WriteSBOMs names it.

title: appbuild.Build
description: Build checks the SDK against the compiler's pinned release and requires a recorded module cache, builds twice with the module proxy off, compares, writes build.json, and writes both SBOMs with WriteSBOMs. It does not read the archetype's pin.

title: appbuild.BuildImage
description: BuildImage copies the build record, the explicit CA bundle and the executable at their trusted digests and checks them (captureTrustedInputs), then writes a scratch image, image.json and the SPDX and CycloneDX SBOMs of the build record.

title: appbuild.SignImage
description: SignImage checks the signature that the CI provider made for itself: it reads image.json at its trusted digest, checks the image, writes the SBOMs again from the build record the image carries, checks each SBOM attestation bundle with the provider's verifier and AcceptableSignature, and only then writes signature.json. It does not make a keyless signature itself.

title: appbuild.PublishImage
description: PublishImage refuses a missing signature input before it reads the record, checks the image against its record and its trusted build record, checks the signature of the image by the trusted signer on a private copy of the manifest, and only then pushes the verified image over TLS with an explicit CA and credentials and reads it back.

title: appbuild.ExportImage
description: ExportImage runs VerifyImage first, writes image.docker.tar with the library's archive writer under a size bound, reads the saved archive back and compares its configuration and layer with the image record, then writes export.json.

title: declaration.Scaffold
description: Scaffold marshals a declaration of kind service with the project's name, the archetype and the archetype's language that the caller gives, and no entity or collection.

title: lifecycle.Supersede
description: Supersede reads the lifecycle of the superseded digest from the lifecycle folder of the registry checkout, refuses a missing successor, a missing statement of a declaration or fill change and a missing summary, applies oneSuccessor (ST-DIS-INV06) and failDateInWindow (ST-DIS-INV12), and only then writes one new OSV advisory named after its next free id; it never changes or replaces an advisory.

title: lifecycle.Withdraw
description: Withdraw reads the lifecycle of the digest from the lifecycle folder of the registry checkout, refuses a missing fail date, a fail date already past, a missing reason and a second withdrawal, and only then writes one new OSV advisory, whose withdrawn time is the time it was recorded.

title: qualify
description: qualify first verifies with release_decision the passed release decision attested at the commit by proof-run.yml at refs/heads/main, through verification.authenticate_subject, and fails when there is none. runs_at keeps only the runs whose head commit is exactly the source commit, so a run of a descendant or an ancestor is never taken. It then selects the runs with select_run, and require_jobs and require_artifacts require every named job and the one signed compiler artifact. Before publication it takes the newest successful signed artifact run, and every artifact must be listed and current. After publication it takes the run and attempt that the release signatures name; an empty artifact list is then accepted only when the run ended more than the seven-day artifact retention ago, and a partial list fails.

title: verify_published_release
description: verify_published_release checks the tag and the immutable release, installs it through installer.install, and compares every asset digest. With attested_runs it takes the one run and attempt that the release bundle names for the executable and the build record, requires the attestation store to name it too, and requires the release notes to hold that run and the compiler digest.

title: install
description: install checks the revision, the platform and the result folder first, downloads each asset by its fixed ID, checks its size and digest, then calls verification.verify.

title: publish-release
description: The publish-release job of the proof run workflow, with contents: write and actions: read, checks out nothing and runs only shell with gh, jq, unzip and coreutils. It verifies the passed release decision at COMMIT with gh attestation verify for proof-run.yml at refs/heads/main, then waits within a bound for the newest successful compiler-artifact.yml run on main at the commit from a push or a dispatch, and stops naming the runs when every run of that workflow at the commit has completed and none can be taken. It downloads the run's two artifacts by their IDs and checks each archive against the listed digest, checks SHA256SUMS, both signatures from that run and the build record, refuses an existing tag or release, runs gh release create at the full commit with --latest=false and the four assets, then fails unless the release is exactly those assets, its tag points at the commit, it is immutable and it is not the latest, and tells the owner what to do.

title: main.runFillCreate
description: runFillCreate resolves the slot, refuses an existing fill or an unsafe name, and writeFillScaffold writes fill.yaml, the code and a test.

title: main.runTest
description: runTest resolves the active slots through compiler.ResolveFillCheck and calls fill.RecordEvidence: for each fill it reads the manifest against the declaration, refuses a fill with no test file or one that breaks the fill rules (fill.checkImports: the import closure of ST-EXT-UC01-R03, the files that are not Go source, the functions with no body and the directives that reach code no import shows, and the calls of ST-EXT-UC01-R05 and ST-EXT-UC01-R07), takes the fill digest and the contract digest, runs go test on the fill, and writes the evidence into fill.yaml when the tests pass. Evidence that names the current state stays. It exits non-zero when a test fails.

title: main.runFillSign
description: runFillSign refuses a fill with no evidence or with stale evidence, reads the person's signing key from git config (gpg.format, user.signingkey), signs the evidence digest with ssh-keygen -Y sign or gpg --detach-sign, and writes the sign-off into fill.yaml. It refuses when no key is set up, and holds no key of its own.

title: compiler.Apply
description: Apply checks the plan against the project, the registry and the compiler (verifyPlanLocation and verifyRegistry in snapshot.go), then commitTransaction in transaction.go writes the files through the journal and saves the record last. It plans in the same run; given a saved plan (Plan.UseSavedPlan, stego apply --saved-plan), it refuses, and writes nothing, unless the new plan gives the same saved plan (SavedPlan.StillApplies in saved_plan.go), and every apply removes the saved plan after it commits. refuseHandEdits stops it, before the journal, while a file that the record lists is missing or no longer matches its hash (Plan.HandEdited), unless the author allows the replacement (Plan.ReplaceHandEdits). The record names the module file that the run writes as the run leaves it. Before it plans, stego apply gets from MissingAddSteps in schema_steps.go the add steps that the declaration lacks against the base, and AppendSchemaSteps writes them at the end of schema_changes and schema_history of service.yaml.

title: compiler.Recover
description: Recover validates the journal against every file, refuses a conflict before it writes, and completes the apply.

title: compiler.SavePlan
description: SavePlan saves the plan that Reconcile in reconciler.go makes in .stego/plan.yaml, with the digests it was made from and the hash of each planned file. It writes no generated file and does not change the record, and refuses while an apply is pending. stego plan calls it.

title: compiler.PackBrowserAssets
description: PackBrowserAssets checks the folder and browserassets.Encode writes the archive; WriteBrowserAssets replaces the output only after every check passes.

title: compiler.WriteArchitecture
description: Not written yet: no apply writes an architecture view.

title: compiler.Initialize
description: Initialize resolves and verifies the registry, takes the archetype's language, holds the project lock, checks that the configuration did not change, then writes the fills folder, the configuration and the scaffold from declaration.Scaffold with exclusive creates, service.yaml last. With no configuration it writes one that names STEGO_REGISTRY, or else the default local registry folder, stego/registry in the user configuration folder (DefaultRegistryFolder), as a local source.

title: registry.LoadDirectories
description: STEGO has no command that writes a component: a platform engineer writes component.yaml, and LoadDirectories accepts it. It decodes the file strictly, refuses a name that differs from its folder, and refuses a slot with no contract file. validateComponentNamespaces in internal/compiler/namespace.go refuses an overlapping namespace when a service is checked.

title: registry.CheckRelease
description: Not written yet: nothing compares a component's emitted code with its version today. This names where that check will live.

title: registry.ResolveRegistry
description: ResolveRegistry reads the sources from .stego/config.yaml, refuses a per-component pin and a bad pin before any source is read, and resolves each pinned Git source or vendored checkout at its exact commit, naming each source by its location and its commit. LoadSources then captures every source before it validates any, and refuses a part or an input path that two sources supply, naming both.

title: registry.ParseArchetypeFromBytes
description: STEGO accepts an archetype when LoadDirectories decodes archetype.yaml through ParseArchetypeFromBytes. It refuses no stage today, and ports.Resolve finds an unanswered or ambiguous port only when a service is checked, not when the archetype is written.

title: registry.ParseMixinFromBytes
description: STEGO accepts a mixin when LoadDirectories decodes mixin.yaml through ParseMixinFromBytes and finds the contract of each slot it adds. Nothing refuses a mixin that replaces a part, or that brings a component that is not ga, yet.

title: Registry.checkSlots
